admission.pipeline_note: scripts/build_strategy_admission.py is the only authorised admission path; it recognises a paper candidate only when the pre-registered matrix lists the family AND its gross is positive. With paper_candidates empty there is nothing to admit, and editing the ledger by hand is refused at load time by design.

paper_run_with_real_market_data.reason: the PAPER_ORDER layer is BLOCKED by the empty admission ledger. Placing a PAPER order anyway would be forcing a trade through a control that exists to stop exactly that, so no order is placed and the layer keeps reporting BLOCKED.
paper_run_with_real_market_data.what_still_runs: INGEST, SIGNALS and SHADOW: read-only market data, the decision projection and observations. They were exercised in WP-TDM-015-OPS and are independent of admission.

mechanical_readiness.conclusion: the order/fill/PnL/reconciliation cycle is mechanically ready (TEST_ONLY evidence). It is not the blocker: the economics are.

economics.reading: volatility@30m earns 8.912 bps gross. Fees are 4.000 bps RT (known). The maker line therefore breaks even only if measured execution cost stays below 4.912 bps; the model currently assumes 5.250 bps for it, which is why the line reads 9.250 bps and kills the cell.

next_experiment.question: is the measured maker execution cost (adverse selection + missed fills) below 4.912 bps for volatility@30m at 200 USD on deep USD-M perpetuals?
next_experiment.kill_switch: measured execution cost >= the threshold closes the intraday OHLCV lane for good; no further indicator search is funded on 5m/15m/30m/1h
next_experiment.why_this_one: it is the only unmeasured component between the best cell and admission: the gross is measured, the fees are known, and the 5.25 bps of execution cost is assumed. Measuring it is the difference between an opinion and a number.
